evidence.reason: At current line 749 the prepare path measures repair.cq_bin but does not require a non-placeholder runtime entry to exist before taking the admission hold. A missing entry can therefore pass preflight and post-drain equality, then fail runtime_pointer_check only after the switch; rollback restores the same missing entry and fails the same check. This is an ordinary deploy-safety bug in existing behavior, and requiring existence earlier is the smallest compatible repair while retaining later checks.
